title: Cloud Functions backend
description: TypeScript Cloud Functions (2nd gen) project with callable/HTTP/trigger/scheduled layout, shared error codes, notifyUser push helper, idempotency helpers, cleanup sample and emulator wiring. Uses yarn.
notes: Cloud Functions require the Blaze (pay as you go) plan.
Functions use yarn (same as the app). Run `yarn --cwd functions install`.
Export every function from functions/src/index.ts between the radiance:functions markers.
See scheduled/cleanupStaleDocs.ts for an onSchedule + batch delete pattern.
notifyUser / notifyUsers in lib/notify.ts send Expo push and FCM to users/{uid}/devices.
Wrap side-effecting handlers in runOnce() from lib/idempotency.ts.
